label: 侧坐后撑（挺拔）
pose_lead: Grounded pose, upright side-sit with rear support:
lower_limbs: Both legs bend at once and gather to one side of the body, thigh and calf layered.
upper_limbs: The arms are placed behind the body, one hand clearly bearing weight on the ground.
torso_head: The chest lifts, the pelvis sits settled, the upper body leaning back a little; the head frontal or slightly turned.
weight_silhouette: The hips are the main anchor with the rear hand steadying the balance; the carriage stays fairly upright and open.
